installCommand: if cd flutter; then git pull && cd ..; else git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b stable --depth 1; fi && flutter/bin/flutter config --enable-web && flutter/bin/flutter pub get
buildCommand: if [ ! -f .env ]; then echo "SUPABASE_URL=$SUPABASE_URL" > .env && echo "SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY" >> .env; fi && flutter/bin/flutter build web --release
